External Storage (CacheStore)

1. What is CacheStore?
  • CacheStore is an interface that allows Ignite to read from and write to an external database (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, etc.);
  • Ignite sits in front of the database as a caching layer: reads go to Ignite first, misses are loaded from the DB, and writes are pushed to the DB;
  • This is useful when you already have data in a relational database and want to accelerate access with in-memory caching;
2. Read-Through and Write-Through
ModeDescription
Read-Through If a key is not in the cache, Ignite automatically calls CacheStore.load() to fetch it from the external DB;
Write-Through When data is written to the cache, Ignite automatically calls CacheStore.write() to persist it to the external DB;
Write-Behind Writes to the external DB are batched and done asynchronously in the background — improves write performance;
3. Implementing CacheStore
  • public class PersonCacheStore extends CacheStoreAdapter<Integer, Person> {

    @Override
    public Person load(Integer key) {
        // Load from external DB
        return jdbc.queryForObject(
            "SELECT * FROM person WHERE id = ?", key);
    }

    @Override
    public void write(Cache.Entry<? extends Integer, ? extends Person> entry) {
        // Write to external DB
        jdbc.update(
            "MERGE INTO person (id, name, age) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            entry.getKey(), entry.getValue().getName(), entry.getValue().getAge());
    }

    @Override
    public void delete(Object key) {
        // Delete from external DB
        jdbc.update("DELETE FROM person WHERE id = ?", key);
    }

    @Override
    public void loadCache(IgniteBiInClosure<Integer, Person> clo, Object... args) {
        // Bulk load from DB into cache on startup
        jdbc.query("SELECT * FROM person", rs -> {
            clo.apply(rs.getInt("id"),
                new Person(rs.getString("name"), rs.getInt("age")));
        });
    }
}
4. Configuring CacheStore
  • CacheConfiguration<Integer, Person> cacheCfg = new CacheConfiguration<>("PersonCache");

cacheCfg.setCacheStoreFactory(FactoryBuilder.factoryOf(PersonCacheStore.class));
cacheCfg.setReadThrough(true);     // enable read-through
cacheCfg.setWriteThrough(true);    // enable write-through
cacheCfg.setWriteBehindEnabled(true); // async writes

// Preload data from DB on startup
ignite.cache("PersonCache").loadCache(null);
5. Write-Behind Configuration
  • Write-behind batches writes to the external DB for better performance: 
    cacheCfg.setWriteBehindEnabled(true);
cacheCfg.setWriteBehindFlushSize(1024);       // flush after 1024 entries
cacheCfg.setWriteBehindFlushFrequency(5000);  // or every 5 seconds
cacheCfg.setWriteBehindBatchSize(512);        // batch size for DB writes
